Ana Rivera: quick follow-up to the telemetry pipeline RFC: thinking of an edge "slimbridge" that prunes high-cardinality attrs but keeps a deterministic billing_key + optional short-lived attr_ref for later enrichment.
CJ Park: doable. must agree canonical keys and derive billing_key at edge (no opaque runtime hops).
Michael Li: main tradeoffs: late-join correctness vs cost savings, and reduced early-hop debuggability.
Sara Gupta: sampling interplay: if sampling occurs after pruning we lose attribution. either sample at edge or include attr_ref so enrichment can fetch full attrs for late samples.
Ana Rivera: attr_ref plan: x-attr-ref = sha256(trace_id + ts), store full attrs in enrichment-cache ttl=48h only for traces flagged by billing predicate.
CJ Park: ops/security: reuse enrichment-cache, require KMS encryption and RBAC for stored attrs. add per-route feature toggle for rollouts.
Michael Li: cache pressure risk. mitigation: only store for ~10% of traces (billing-sensitive), TTL + LRU. CJ can run capacity numbers.
Sara Gupta: rollout: canary 1% traffic on low-risk routes for 24h, monitor billing delta, queryability regressions, and "missing-attr" errors.
ingest-bot: created deploy checklist item #4007 for "edge-slimbridge-gate" (assignee: CJ Park).
Ana Rivera: actions: CJ -> capacity spreadsheet + PR; Michael -> spike on cache integration; Sara -> SLOs + canary plan; Ana -> RFC update with pseudocode. target: behind flag in 2 sprints.
